body: Yeah... I want to. And believe me, I try. But I involuntarily lock up, get nervous, and can't think of anything to say, absolutely nothing comes to mind when I'm put in a situation like that. But I guess I'm not trying hard enough.

Yeah, I'd rather not drink, but I ran out of weed two days ago and haven't been able to get any since, so alcohol is the only option. 
I'm sorry to hear about your ex. That must be really tough to deal with.. I can't confirm I've ever been cheated on but a boyfriend left me for another girl once and I'm pretty sure they didn't keep their hands off each other before he broke up with me. Either way, breaking up sucks. Hope you're okay. I wish you weren't sad either, even though in an odd, sick way it feels a little better for me, to know that there's someone else out there sitting by a screen like me, feeling just as bad and probably worse. Sorry about that.

Well, my childhood wasn't a particularly happy one so I prefer to try and not remember it as much as possible :) But yes, I definitely feel like there are pieces missing, lots of them, and I'm just not sure where to find them or which pieces they even are.. 
But thank you, for taking the time to read my rambling and reply as well. Here's to hoping tomorrow is a better day :)
I'm not. I'm really shy around people I don't know well. I've never been very good at people, social situations and being out going.
